title: Protobuf (proto3) schema as source of truth + generated JSON Schema for JSON Lines
notes: Decision in roadmap-standard: protobuf primary, Arrow for bulk, NPZ read-only, FlatBuffers not chosen. 2026-11-15 done: spec/proto/neuraltextstream/v1/*.proto (8 files, package neuraltextstream.v1, 25 messages, 19 enums) cover the full NTS 1.0 RC2 data model (header + 3 declarations, frame dense/sparse, segment_end, end, signal_quality, decision, hypothesis + evidence + decode_declaration, pointer, intent, intent_feedback, control, control_enable, trust_decision text/intent/control, LSL gap, timing + binding keys); field comments cite rule ids. Mapping rules (package/versioning, field number ranges 1-15/16-899/900 Timing/1000 Binding/2047 ext, NTS JSON mapping: flat type discriminator, snake_case keys, enum json_value strings, ints as numbers, null_binary; unknown keys -> ext, unknown types -> UnknownEvent) in spec/proto/README.md (informative). Generated spec/schemas/nts-v1.schema.json by tools/proto/gen_jsonschema.py (stdlib parser; check_protoc.py proves parser = protoc via grpcio-tools 1.85.1, not committed). Parity (tools/proto/parity.py, tests/test_proto_schema.py, CI job proto): 287 vectors, 164 compared (91 accept + 73 schema rejects) match, 0 mismatches, built-in validator = jsonschema 4.26.0; 90 rejects not compared (cross-line 28, binding 21, trust 17, cross-field 10, arithmetic 7, parse 4, lexical GEN-5 3); 33 NPZ out of scope. Open spec questions Q-1..Q-8 in spec/CHANGELOG.md (null in optional fields, LSL reason key / gap fields, control reasons enum, declaration/input tables, integer range, cross-profile field types, new enum values in a minor (most important), SDK checks without rule text). RC2 Appendix C.3 added (informative, additive). Hand-written schemas and SDK behaviour unchanged.
